blocks.text: For a late departure and a strong reported seat count, I’d first investigate the Aeroplan option via Hong Kong. If arriving in Bangkok earlier matters more, the earlier-departing Hong Kong option is a useful alternative; the Taiwan connection offers a different route and earlier arrival still.

This Aeroplan economy award has 9 reported seats and a 70-minute Hong Kong connection. It shares the 65,000-point amount and CAD 107.40 reported fees with the other Hong Kong option below, but points and fee quote scopes are unknown. Its drawback is the short connection and a later Bangkok arrival than the earlier-departing alternatives.
blocks.label: Late-departure Hong Kong award

blocks.text: Also Aeroplan economy, with 9 reported seats, a 70-minute Hong Kong connection, and the same reported points and fees as the late-departure option. It arrives 11h 25m earlier, but leaves 11h 30m earlier; its elapsed journey is 5 minutes longer. Choose it for the earlier arrival, not for a meaningful time-saving en route.
blocks.label: Earlier-arriving Hong Kong award

blocks.text: This Aeroplan economy option via Taipei arrives 8h 25m earlier than the late-departure Hong Kong award, but departs 11h 15m earlier and takes 2h 50m longer. It reports 1 seat and CAD 116.50 in fees, versus 9 seats and CAD 107.40 on that Hong Kong option; both fee scopes are unknown. Its 4h 30m Taipei connection and BR-operated itinerary may suit a traveler prioritizing this route, but the earlier arrival comes with a much earlier start.
